EmailTemplate.subject: Update: Charge Limits
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
I hope this note finds you well and staying healthy. We wanted to reach out to provide you with an update on the adjustments Flywire recently made to your portal regarding the processing of credit card transactions in an effort to minimise risk for your institution resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic.
Due to the ongoing uncertainty and risk of chargebacks to your organisation, we had recently paused credit card transactions for your organisation. We realise that you may not have received advance notice and apologise for the oversight. Please note that this change only applied to credit cards, and your students and parents still have access to many other preferred payment options, including bank transfer which continues to be a top choice for students and institutions.
As schools start to re-open across the UK, our team is working diligently to reassess those impacted. We will complete our review over the next two weeks and our Client Success Team will be in contact with one of the following assessments:
- Credit card transactions will be re-enabled automatically
- Credit card transactions will be re-enabled, but will remain under review and may require further information from you over a subsequent period of time - Credit card transactions will remain paused until we have a further conversation and request additional information from you
Again, we want to assure you that all changes and monitoring actions were made in an effort to minimise the disruption and risk to your organisation from increased chargebacks. In the meantime, we want to ensure our clients continue to have alternative ways to securely collect payments from students and parents around the world.
Thanks in advance for your understanding, and please be on the lookout for our follow-up communication. As always, please let us know if you have questions or concerns.
Sincerely,
Simon Read VP, Education, EMEA Flywire Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States Copyright ©Flywire. 2011-2020 All rights reserved.
